## Lazy lines

- [ ] card with a lazy line
continues the card
%% a comment line inside the card %%
- [ ] card with a body and a lazy line
	indented body
lazy after the body
- [ ] last card of the list

A paragraph after a blank line ends the list.

- [ ] second list item, not a card

## After a comment

- [ ] first card
- [ ] second card
<!-- a comment ends the list -->
- [ ] not a card

## Quote

- [ ] card before a quote
- [ ] another card
> a quote ends the list
- [ ] not a card either

## Multi-line comment

- [ ] card one
- [ ] card two

<!--
## not a lane inside a comment
-->

## Last

- [ ] last lane card
